player_prompt.intro:
Nang tsaw ra Player {player_id} HighSociety kawp (2-player version) na.
Kawp hkying:  Prestige card shi hkying zawn reng reng.
Lahtaw:    Lahtaw shi hkying, money card 1-11 hpe jawm ra hte tsun.
            • Lahtaw masu jawm ra prestige card hpe tsaw ra hte money card hpe pawt.
            • Lahtaw mahkra jawm ra money card hpe hti.
            • Tie -> lahtaw shanu pawt ra hte prestige card hpe shi hkying zawn.
Kawp aten:    Lahtaw shi hkying zawn reng reng, **money shawng + prestige aten** hpe tsawm.
            *Net-worth* masu jawm ra tsaw (tie mahkra -> draw).

**Lahtaw syntax**  →  money card shi hkying '[7]' hte '[11]' zawn.
